sloka: श्रुत्वा तु वचनम् तासाम् सर्वासाम् हृदयम् गमम् ।गमनाय मतिम् चक्रे तम् च निन्युः तथा स्त्रियः ॥१-१०-२८॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanam tāsām sarvāsām hṛdayam gamam ।gamanāya matim cakre tam ca ninyuḥ tathā striyaḥ ॥1-10-28॥

translations.english: As the illustrious sage was being brought (to Anga) the god of rain (Parjanya) suddenly inundated the earth which looked cherful (with rain).
